description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at a cutoff of 10 (MRR@10) as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S), ranging from 2 to 10 on a linear x-axis with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, also linear, spans from 33.0 to 36.0 in increments of 0.5, representing MRR@10 performance. Four distinct lines are plotted: the black solid line labeled “DPR w/o query” remains flat at approximately 34.3 across all values of S, indicating no change in performance regardless of the number of queries. The red line with circular markers, “DPR w/ corpus expansion,” starts at about 35.1 when S=2 and rises steadily to approximately 36.0 at S=10, showing consistent improvement with more queries. The green line with triangular markers, “DPR w/ document expansion,” begins near 34.8 and exhibits a gradual upward trend, reaching about 35.5 at S=10. In contrast, the blue line with star markers, “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion,” starts at roughly 34.8 but declines steadily to approximately 34.0 by S=10, indicating deteriorating performance as more queries are used. A legend in the bottom-right corner identifies each line by its label, color, and marker style.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) at a cutoff of 10, with respect to the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis represents the 'Number of queries used during inference (S)', using a linear scale ranging from 2 to 10, marked at intervals of 2. The y-axis shows 'MRR@10', also on a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four lines. The first line is 'DPR w/o query' with black, solid, without markers, depicting a constant value of approximately 34.3 across the entire x-axis. The second line is 'DPR w/ corpus expansion', red, with circle markers and a solid style, beginning at an approximate value of 35.1 and increasing steadily to a value of around 36.0 by the x-axis end. The third line is green, with triangle markers and a solid line, starting at about 34.8 and showing a consistent upward trend, ending at around 35.5 at x = 10. The fourth line is blue, with star markers and a solid style, starting at approximately 34.8 and showing a sharp decline to about 34.0 towards the end of the x-axis. A legend is given at the bottom right.
